name: tfl_ccz_camera_captures
title: TfL Congestion Charge zone: camera captures and confirmed vehicles, by month
description: How many vehicles TfL's Congestion Charge cameras recorded in the charging zone each month during charging hours, from July 2010: total camera captures, and (from October 2016) the number of confirmed vehicles observed, with the number of charging days in the month. Published by Transport for London on the London Datastore. One row per month.

sources.title: Transport for London, via the London Datastore — Camera Captures and Confirmed Vehicles seen in the Congestion Charge Zone by Month (tfl-vehicles-c-charge-zone.csv)

update_cadence: TfL adds each month roughly six weeks after it ends; checked weekly.
caveats: Counts are for charging hours on charging days only. Charging hours and days have changed over the series (notably 7-day charging from June 2020, and later changes to evening and weekend hours), so compare months per charging day and treat those changes as breaks in the series.
The two measures are TfL's, under TfL's names; the dataset itself carries no fuller definition. Neither is a count of traffic flow past a point, and there is no split by vehicle type.
confirmed_vehicles is blank before October 2016. In a few recent months it equals or exceeds camera_captures (e.g. May and September 2026); figures are published as TfL gives them.
The zone covers central London, including most but not all of the City of Westminster.
notes is TfL's free-text note of non-charging days in the month, verbatim.
There is no row for April 2020: TfL suspended the charge from 23 March to 18 May 2020 (Covid-19) and publishes nothing for that month; March and May 2020 cover only their charging days.
Covid-19: 2020 and 2021 reflect restrictions and recovery; do not use them as a baseline.
